title: PROP-104 Phase 0 analyze + report — 9+ decider runs of STEP_MARKER-instrumented transcripts have accumulated since PROP-104 Phase 0 shipped 2026-06-17. Run monitor/scripts/compute-decider-step-cost.js against each available decider transcript, write a consolidated finding to monitor/integrity/decider-step-cost-summary-*.json, and produce the Phase 0 → Phase 1 decision-evidence the_correction_up_front section asked for.
context:
PROP-104 Phase 0 shipped 2026-06-17T05:45Z:
  - monitor/scripts/compute-decider-step-cost.js (the analyzer)
  - 16 STEP_MARKER breadcrumbs in decider.md (priorities 1, 1b, 2, 2b, 2c, 3, 3b, 4, 5, 5b + end-of-run A0/A0b/A0c/A0d/A/B)

PROP-104's stated EXIT criteria for Phase 0:
  "≥5 runs of source-attributed token data + ≥20 runs of shadow routing comparison + operator review of mechanism_b context-source attribution."

As of 2026-06-20T08:00Z, the count of decider runs with STEP_MARKERs present: ~9 (cost-history.jsonl shows 9 decider rows since 2026-06-14, and STEP_MARKERs were added 2026-06-17 so ~6 runs would have them; the other 3 are from before). Sufficient for the ≥5 source-attributed runs criterion.

The operator hasn't run the analyzer yet. The transcripts are present (somewhere under /sessions/) and the analyzer is shipped. What's missing is the actual analysis pass + the consolidation.

The_correction_up_front from PROP-104 itself: "The directive's premise that state-file content dominates decider's cache_read may be wrong — the heavy state files are inside bash node -e blocks that print SHORT summaries. Most state-file content is parsed in subprocess and discarded; only printed stdout enters tool_result and thus LLM context. cache_read per turn = the entire growing conversation prefix (system prompt + decider.md 1334L + reference files + accumulated tool_result outputs + 136-158 turns). Phase 0 MUST distinguish three cache_read sources: (a) static prompt prose, (b) accumulated verbose tool_result output, (c) any Read-tool state-file loads. The fix differs per source: (a)→prompt-slim, (b)→trim what bash prints + fewer turns, (c)→precompute artifact. Phase 0 settles it with data, not assumption."

This directive asks tinker to RUN that settlement. The shipping of the analyzer was preparatory; the actual analysis is the work.

Operator-evidence supplemental added 2026-06-16: the H1 (standalone confabulation) vs H2 (context-pressure-induced confabulation) hypothesis split, traced to the 06-16T10:00 decider summary-writer hallucination. Phase 0 mechanism_b should also pick up output-token bucketing per step + retrospective grep of historical decider summaries for self-history-confabulation patterns (e.g. 'context-resumed', 'continuation of') correlated with run size. If confabulation rate increases sharply above a threshold, that's H2 evidence (and ALL PROP-104 working-set reduction directly fixes it). If flat/random, H1 (and a different intervention is needed).

Other-side check the operator already considered:
- ARGUE-AGAINST: 'The analyzer is shipped; the operator can run it any time without a directive.' Counter: tinker has the cycle budget and the discipline for systematic analysis. Operator-cowork can do this but it's exactly the kind of multi-transcript per-step analysis tinker was designed for.
- ARGUE-AGAINST: 'Phase 0 should accumulate more runs first.' Counter: PROP-104's stated ≥5-run threshold is already met. Adding more runs without an interim analysis means delaying any Phase 1 decision, possibly indefinitely. Tinker should produce the interim analysis NOW, document the per-step distribution, then operator decides whether Phase 1 ships based on that evidence or whether more measurement is needed.
- ARGUE-AGAINST: 'The H1/H2 confabulation question can wait.' Counter: PROP-104 explicitly added that to the Phase 0 scope via operator_evidence_added_2026-06-16. Punting it means re-loading the context later.
task: Run monitor/scripts/compute-decider-step-cost.js against every decider transcript from 2026-06-17 onward (when STEP_MARKERs were added) and write a consolidated PROP-NNN finding. Address PROP-104 Phase 0 acceptance criteria: per-step input/cache/output bucketing for ≥5 decider runs, mechanism_b context-source attribution (% of input tokens that are (a) static prompt prose vs (b) accumulated tool_result output vs (c) Read-tool state-file loads), and the H1 vs H2 confabulation diagnostic.
investigation_questions: Q1 — Discover the decider transcripts. PROP-104 Phase 0 shipped 2026-06-17T05:45Z; decider transcripts since then live under /sessions/ as .jsonl files. Use the same transcript-discovery logic write-self-cost.sh uses (find /sessions/ -readable -name '*.jsonl' -newer SOMEDATE). Confirm at least 5 decider runs with STEP_MARKER breadcrumbs present.

Q2 — Run the analyzer against each transcript. node monitor/scripts/compute-decider-step-cost.js <transcript> > monitor/integrity/decider-step-cost-<RUN_ID>.json. Capture all 9+ runs. Surface any analyzer failures (silent-skip, partial-data) and note them.

Q3 — Aggregate per-step distribution. Across all runs: top-3 steps by input tokens, top-3 by cache_read tokens, top-3 by output tokens, top-3 by tool_result-size buckets (mechanism_b's largest producers). Spot the outliers — is one step responsible for 40%+ of the cost? If so, that's the headline.

Q4 — mechanism_b context-source attribution. For each run, compute the (a)/(b)/(c) split: (a) static prompt prose (sum of bytes of decider.md + reference files actually loaded — measurable as a floor), (b) accumulated tool_result output (sum of bytes from tool_result_buckets_top20 + extrapolation for the rest), (c) Read-tool state-file loads (input minus (a) minus (b) — residual). Hypothesize from PROP-104's the_correction_up_front: (a)+(b) should dominate, (c) should be near-zero. Verify or refute.

Q5 — H1 vs H2 confabulation diagnostic. Walk all decider's latest-decider-summary.txt files from 2026-06-14 onward (PROP-101 onward) and grep for self-history confabulation patterns: 'context-resumed', 'continuation of', 'as I was working on', 'when I previously'. For each match, look up the corresponding cost-history.jsonl row (model, assistant_msgs, cache_read tokens, duration_sec) and correlate. If confabulation rate increases sharply above a threshold, that's H2 evidence (and PROP-104 working-set reduction IS the fix). If flat/random, H1 (and a different intervention is needed). Report the correlation.

Q6 — Phase 1 decision recommendation. Based on Q3+Q4+Q5, recommend one of three Phase 1 paths: (i) PRECOMPUTE — if (c) Read-tool state-file loads dominate, the originally-named PROP-104 Phase 1 precompute artifact path is right. (ii) PROMPT-SLIM — if (a) static prompt prose dominates, the prompt-slim of decider.md + reference files conditional loading is right (PROP-040 Phase 2 territory). (iii) BASH-OUTPUT-TRIM — if (b) accumulated tool_result output dominates, the lever is trimming what bash node -e blocks print to stdout (smaller summaries, fewer printlines per loop, batched output). Possibly a mix. The recommendation should be evidence-backed by the actual % split.

Q7 — Confidence interval / next-measurement-needs. State explicitly what the 5+ runs are sufficient to conclude vs what would need more data. e.g. 'we can claim (b) is X% with N=5 to ±10pp; tighter bounds need N=20.' Mirror PROP-104's own discipline of bounded claims.

Q8 — Coordinate with PROP-022 phase 6 reconsideration. PROP-104's the_correction noted that closed-issues.json bulk DOES NOT enter context — the parsing happens in subprocess. PROP-105 already confirmed PROP-022 phase 6 should stay deferred (decider parse cost was 0.011% of run-time). This directive's Q4 should explicitly verify that conclusion holds in the actual per-run data: closed-issues.json reads should appear as small tool_result entries (one-line print summaries), not as large ones.
deliverable: A PROP-NNN proposal in monitor/tinker/proposals/ with: (1) Q1-Q2 transcript discovery + analyzer run results; (2) Q3 aggregated per-step distribution with top-3 token-consumers; (3) Q4 mechanism_b context-source attribution with %a/%b/%c split + verification of PROP-104 the_correction hypothesis; (4) Q5 H1/H2 confabulation diagnostic with correlation analysis; (5) Q6 Phase 1 path recommendation (precompute / prompt-slim / bash-output-trim / mix); (6) Q7 confidence-interval + next-measurement-needs statement; (7) Q8 PROP-022 phase 6 verification. Propose-only; operator reviews + decides Phase 1 path based on the evidence.
constraints: Do NOT add behavioral changes to decider.md as part of this analysis. The work is read-only measurement + finding. Phase 1 implementations land in a separate PROP after operator review of this directive's deliverable.
Honor PROP-104's bounded-claims discipline. If N=5 isn't sufficient for a particular conclusion, say so + recommend more measurement.

If the analyzer fails on some transcripts (e.g. STEP_MARKERs weren't emitted that run — possible for runs that hit context exhaustion before reaching certain steps), report the failure + reason. Don't synthesize plausible-sounding data.
Use compute-decider-step-cost.js verbatim. The instrumentation was shipped and tested; don't fork it to add features unless the analysis genuinely needs them and a separate amendment is filed.
